lines.en: : So, are we going to talk about what just happened?
: Nope.
: I feel like we should probably talk about what just happened.
: Nope.
: I also feel like you probably should have washed your hands sometime between leaving the basement and now.
: Just saying.
: Okay. I think it’s my turn to be suicidal.
: Wait, stop. That’s the only thing I have going for me right now.
: The only thing? You just plowed the heart of Kumon-mi into unconsciousness and you think your defining characteristic is how much you currently want to jump off of a bridge?
: I think the sex part’s become so normal in my everyday life that I often just omit it.
: I see now why you’ve become such a depressing mess over the last few months. I can only imagine how miserable I would be if I got to bone Niki Nakayama whenever I wanted. Sounds like hell.
: Hey, at least you’ve got a picture now. That was more than you had before.
: I won’t rest until I have sexual intercourse with everyone you know. This is my mission.
: The hell were you two getting it on down there for anyway? Do you have any idea what you’ve done? I’m never going to be able to take another lesson without having Vietnam-style flashbacks now.
: Hey, you could have left whenever you wanted. Don’t blame me for your voyeuristic compulsion to spy on couples clearly engaging in a very private act with one another.
: That-
: Well...
: ...Shut up.
: Good one.
: Well, what would you have done in my shoes? I might never get another opportunity to see Niki in a position like that for as long as I live. I wasn’t just gonna walk away.
: Yeah, it makes a lot more sense to just masturbate in front of your teacher instead.
: Former teacher. I never would have done that if you were still employed and pretending to be responsible for my education.
: I mean, I am still employed if you want to get technical about this.
: Nope. Doesn’t count. What I did back there was no different than just watching porn and I hereby reclaim any innocence I may have lost in doing so. Thank you.
: So, when you were fingering yourself, were you thinking more about her or-
: Obviously her! If it was you I was interested in, I would have invited you along for Rin’s maiden voyage to climax city.
: You should have. You’ve now witnessed my powers firsthand and must accept that you’ve missed out on something potentially very special by not inviting me.

: Sorry, Akira. I was too busy listening to you pork my psycho roommate and wound up boarding the ship alone. But I’ll give you a call the next time I’m coerced into a private room with a different classmate.
: I see now that we share a common goal in collecting the bodies of our mutual acquaintances.
: Hah...
: You shouldn’t be doing that. You still haven’t washed your hands.
: I used my other hand for that. And it’s not my goal to collect bodies. If that’s what I cared about, I wouldn’t have rejected ten million people at my last school.
: Oh, right. Sometimes I forget how popular you were back then since the only person you ever hang out with now is Nodoka.
: That’s not true. You exist. Even if I don’t really want you to.
: That’s fair. I don’t really want me to exist either. But I do hope you know that I’m going to hold this over your head for the rest of your life.
: Yeah, I figured as much. But I wouldn’t get too comfortable with that since I’m still acutely aware that you’re screwing multiple girls and could use that to sabotage all of your relationships.
: Joke’s on you, I’ll probably wind up sabotaging them on my own before you even have a chance to.
: Yeah, that’s why it isn’t worth it. That and the fact that I’m kind of starting to get attached to you now for whatever reason.
: Thanks, Otoha. I feel like this would be a really cute moment for us if I hadn’t watched you discreetly finger yourself twenty minutes ago.
: Silly me for thinking you’d keep your eyes on, oh- I don’t know, the girl you were having sex with?
: It’s like you said about Niki, I might never get to see you in another position like that for as long as I live.
: Yeah, but you haven’t had a crush on me for years like I have with her.
: What if I had, though? But I’m just really bad at expressing myself and could never figure out how to tell you that you’re the one I want out of everyone in Kumon-mi?
: Uhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh no.
: Man, I really hope you let down those millions of girls a lot gentler than that.
: And I really hope that we can figure out a way to put this behind us and file it in whatever drawer we’re keeping the hotel sex-fest in.
: Unfortunately for you, I keep all of my secrets in a single drawer that doesn’t even lock. And it’s only a matter of time until someone else finds out whether we want them to or not.
: Can you, maybe...I don’t know, lock it then? Because I don’t really think I want anyone else finding out I touched myself in front of two of my teachers.
: I know a solution to this.
: You definitely don’t.
: You have to complete the trifecta and touch yourself in front of Imani next. That way, all of your teachers will know and we’ll all be on equal footing. Your problem will be solved.
: Sure. Just let me know when you fuck her and I’ll be right there to do that.
: Oh, wait a minute. Imani is one of the few people you’re not having sex with, isn’t she?
: Why do you know that?
: Probably because her situation isn’t all that different from mine.
: And also the fact that your disappearance made her start acting super weird and cranky all the time.
: And also the part where I overheard her tell Miss Watabe that she, and I quote — “Needs to get laid like, yesterday.”
: Is this just what you do now? Go around spying on people?
: No, but it’s seriously starting to feel like that. I keep walking in on shit I’m not supposed to see or hear.
: Like, just the other day, I-
: And like, I’m not that much younger, am I? Like, I’m in high school. She doesn’t have to make me feel like some kind of kid.
: Uhh...what just happened?
: Huh? What do you mean?
: Weren’t we just outside? Did I black out again?
: Uhh...I don’t think so? You’ve seemed pretty normal to me. But we’ve been in here for like fifteen minutes, dude.
: Wasn’t your tie just black as well?
: Oh, yeah. It’s a special color-changing tie. Now, you won’t ever have to ask about it again.
: Works for me.
Well, it appears that I have, once again, lost a chunk of the day to whatever higher power decided to extract it from me this time.
And while that’s fine and all considering it brings me one step closer to pulling the covers over my head again, I’d like for them to stop screwing around and just take me back to nighttime already.
Oh but, going forward, they can leave in the parts where girls show up and touch themselves to me as well. I’d like if I can still experience those.

Everything else, though? Fuck it. Like, not literally. Okay, maybe a little literally. But not like literally a little literally. You know? Fuck it. Literally. Just not because I can’t even control when I get hard anymore.

It either happens or it doesn’t. And when it does, it’s violent. But when it doesn’t, it’s nothing. It’s like, numb. It’s like, I can’t even describe it. It’s just numb. It’s either violent or it’s numb. Sex. You know?
: So...what were we talking about just now?
: Oh, I was just ranting about Niki again. Which I’m sure is annoying as shit, so you can just tell me to knock it off and I will.
: Otoha, if you like Niki as much as you obviously do, why did you ever agree to date Rin in the first place?
: You said this has been going on for years, didn’t you? What’s the point of going into a relationship you’re not fully on board with?
: I don’t know. Why did you go into a relationship with Niki while you were already boning Chika? Hearts and brains are stupid. They don’t always make sense.
: So it’s...sexually motivated then?
: No...it wasn’t like that. It was more, like...curiosity, I guess? And...submission, maybe?
: Like, I don’t want to say I was just settling for Rin because anything with Niki seemed like such a long shot. But that’s also...kind of what it was?
: But not in the sense where it, like...makes her look bad. Because she was great. And I do like her, just...not like that.
: It was more like...trying to bring myself back to reality or...whatever. Shooting for something achievable for once instead of always keeping my eyes on the clouds like I was raised to do.

: But reality is just so fucking boring, man. Like, my very limited experience with dating is no different from anything you’d see in some shitty Netflix movie. It was just drama and crying and making out.
: Well, what do you want?
: Something real. Something...I don’t know...exciting. But not too exciting because then it becomes exhausting.
: I just want it to, like...feel right. But nothing ever feels right. With anyone.
: I don’t know. Maybe this whole dating thing just isn’t for me. That’s kind of what I figured from the get-go. But then Niki went and activated all of my hormones and now I just feel weird.
: It’s just, like...there are so many songs about true love and...falling in love...being in love...the things that love can make you do...and I, like...can’t write those. And that sucks.
: There’s this whole aspect of life and music that I want to understand. But every time I try to understand it, I want to rip my fucking hair out.
: But Niki gets that. And despite what the Internet might say about idol culture and shit, she’s a real artist. She writes her own music...lyrics...and it’s all so personal, but...accessible too.
: And you figure she’d be able to show you more of that world?
: I think so? But I also can’t look at her without wanting her to push me to the ground and have her way with me. So that’s a world I want to be a part of too, I guess.
: Yeah, I like that world a little more.
: Do you really, though? Because, and this is older-sister Otoha speaking now, what if you’re only this fucked up because that’s the world you’re living in?
: What if you’re like me in that regard? Aware that there’s this extra dimension that could make your life so much better, and you’re just...infinitely stumbling while trying to make it there?
: I think that’s just what living is.
: This isn’t living. What we’re doing isn’t living. Look at Niki. Look at Rin. They know who they are. And yeah, they’ve got their problems as well, but do you think they’re worried about this shit?
: Hell no. They’ve got their own values and...people they care about and...there’s no fear of what lies beyond any invisible forcefield since they’ve already passed through them all.
: Can we really say we’re living before we have the faintest idea what our lives even are?
: I know what my life is, Otoha. You-
: No! That’s- ugh! See, this is why you’re so annoying.
: It’s that, like...fatalist mindset of yours. That “I’ve fallen too far and can’t possibly climb back up” bullshit that people who give up cling to.

: It’d be so fucking easy for me to do the same god damn thing. To just be, like “Oh, I’m a bad person. I guess I’m just going to suck forever,” and then live out the rest of my life as a loser-douche hybrid.
: But I want to be more than that. And you should want to be more than that.
: Because if we don’t get our shit together, we’re both going to wind up masturbating in front of people we care about. And not in a good way!
: That took a weird turn.
: I’m trying!
: Did you wash your hands?
: Yes!
: Otoha...
: Akira.
: I really do like you, you know.
: No matter how nicely you ask, I will not let you watch me again. And no, I am not sorry.
: That’s not what I’m getting at. I just appreciate that you can still find the time to talk to me like this despite having no clue what’s going on in your own life.
: You don’t have to thank me. Just...reciprocate it. Because that’s all I’ve ever wanted from you.
: I don’t feel comfortable talking to my parents about shit like this. And it’s not like I can vent to Niki about how badly I want her to tackle me.
: So for the most part, I’ve always just figured shit out on my own. But I’ve always wanted someone to, like...be there. You know? Whether it be trading advice or...just listening.
: And a teacher made the most sense. Like...I don’t have any siblings...and everyone my age just wants to fuck me.
: Which, to be fair, you do as well. But I’m willing to overlook that if it means being able to come to you when I need something.
: Something that isn’t sex.
: You’ve had other teachers before, Otoha. Were none of them up to your standards? Or are you just settling for me now like you did with Rin?
: I’ve never had a teacher like you before. And that’s both a good and a bad thing.
: It’s bad because, like I just mentioned, you want to fuck me. And everyone else. And I’m sure I don’t have to tell you why that is wrong.
: But it’s good because you’re the first person who isn’t constantly reminding me that I can do better.

: And yeah, that might be sort of counterintuitive to the whole “being a teacher” thing. But at the end of the day, your job is to inspire. And being reminded of how talented I am isn’t inspiring. It’s tiring.
: You look at me like a person, not a student. So maybe what I wanted wasn’t a teacher at all.
: It was a friend.
: That was really fucking lame, Otoha.
: Yeah, I’m cringing pretty hard right now, not gonna lie.
: No, I just mean you missed another good opportunity to call me your brother.
: That was on purpose. I didn’t want you to make things sexual again.
: A-hah. So you admit you’re what the kids would call a “brocon.”
: I don’t like that you know that word.
: Good. Because, while I’ll always be here for you to trade advice with, I’m going to make it even more of a point to make your life a living hell from now on.
: Meaning what, exactly?
: Meaning we’ll figure this shit out together.
: That...what does that have to do with the “living hell” part? What are you going to do to me?
: I’m not sure. But it looks like we’ll have to find out next time since the scene has already faded to black.
: Wha- what scene?! We’re in fucking McDonald’s! Stop being weird!
: At the time, we had no idea...but that conversation would change everything. It was truly the beginning...of something wonderful.
: Stop narrating our conversation! And eat your fucking French fries!
Otoha begins throwing food at my head.
And I open up some more space in my decaying heart for her.
Otoha’s affection has increased to [otoha_love]!
